description: This file contains utility functions for handling input validation, IP address, URL, MAC address, port, ID validation, as well as some session and locale setup. It also includes CSRF protection initialization, making it a core utility source file in a PHP-based web application.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the input string consists only of printable ASCII characters within a specified range or all printable characters if no range is specified.

methods.name: noSpace
methods.description: Checks if the input contains at least one non-whitespace character.

methods.name: validIPAddr
methods.description: Validates whether the provided IP address is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates whether the provided string is a valid URL as per URL syntax.

methods.name: validMAC
methods.description: Validates whether the provided MAC address is valid and not all zeros, also checking for the first byte being even.

methods.name: validPort
methods.description: Checks if the port number is within the valid range 1-65535.

methods.name: validId
methods.description: Checks if the ID is in the range 1-256.

methods.name: validId_PC
methods.description: Validates parental control IDs, allowing formats like '10' or '10_12'.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: isValInRange
methods.description: Checks if a numerical value falls within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: validURL
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation to ensure a URL string is valid, supporting IPv4, IPv6, and domain-based URLs.

methods.name: validTime
methods.description: Validates that start and end times are in correct HH:MM format, within the 00:00-23:59 range, and that start time is before end time.

methods.name: validDays
methods.description: Checks if the list of days contains only valid weekdays.

methods.name: valid_ssid_name
methods.description: Validates SSID name length, character set, and prevents the use of reserved or blacklisted substrings.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Checks for absence of prohibited special characters in the string.

methods.name: remove_special_char
methods.description: Returns true if string does not contain specified special characters.
